item.title: Trade agreement talks unlikely to be resolved by July 1: U.S. trade representative
item.description: WASHINGTON — United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Tuesday that he doesn't expect negotiations on the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement on trade to be resolved by July 1.

item.title: Almost a third of police probes of diplomatic missions see subjects leave Canada
item.description: OTTAWA — Almost a third of police probes involving members of foreign diplomatic missions in Canada in the last five years saw the subjects of the investigations leave the country before charges were laid or prosecuted.

item.title: David Eby confident Indigenous MLAs will vote to pause B.C's DRIPA legislation
item.description: VICTORIA — British Columbia Premier David Eby said he's sure his government will retain the legislature's confidence and pass his plan to suspend sections of the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act that he says pose a legal peril.

item.title: Ontario MP Marilyn Gladu says she's joining Carney's Liberal government
item.description: OTTAWA — Ontario MP Marilyn Gladu left the Conservative caucus to join Prime Minister Mark Carney's Liberals on Wednesday, pushing the government closer to a majority ahead of three byelections next week.

item.title: BC United was secretly behind website calling for Rustad to be fired: Elections BC
item.description: Elections BC says a website set up in 2024 to demand the firing of then B.C. Conservative leader John Rustad wasn't the work of disgruntled members, as it claimed, but was instead created on the orders of the rival BC United Party.

item.title: Sobeys recalls some products containing cheese over listeria risk
item.description: Grocery store giant Sobeys is recalling a number of products containing cheese because of possible listeria contamination.

item.title: Police in the Bahamas arrest husband of US woman who vanished from boat
item.description: Police in the Bahamas said late Wednesday they have arrested the husband of a U.S. woman who was aboard a boat near the archipelago and vanished.

item.title: Carney praises Hansen, calls hearing French from space a point of pride
item.description: LONGUEUIL — Prime Minister Mark Carney praised astronaut Jeremy Hansen during a call with the Artemis II crew on Wednesday, saying he was proud to see a Canadian in space and to hear French spoken.

item.title: Hawaii doctor accused of trying to kill his wife convicted of attempted manslaughter
item.description: HONOLULU (AP) — A Hawaii anesthesiologist who was accused of trying to murder his wife on a scenic cliffside hike with ocean views last year has been convicted of the lesser charge of attempted manslaughter.
